sources.title: naftulikay/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model was obtained by quantizing Qwen3.8-Flash-Next to NVFP4, ready for inference with SGLang. Only the routed experts of the 48 main-model MoE layers are quantized (fused gate_up_proj / down_proj; 294,912 quantized tensor entries) to NVFP4 W4A4 (E2M1, group size 16, FP8 E4M3 block scales, FP32 global scales, dynamic NVFP4 activations).

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 | Model Validation · PINVOU
sources.snippet: Model architecture & capabilities Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model for general Q&A and agent tasks. It uses sparse experts, hybrid attention, and embedding components that support tiered loading, drawing on a subset of compute resources at each step. Total parameters, active parameters per step, and actual device memory use are distinct measures.
